objective: Computation. Every non-planar knot space of the census and every splice of the Fano plane with a planar census space (both ways), minus each line, with each order of its ports, attached at a ladder: which faces its far halo uses (opposite, own, both or none). Check the claim rule on every case, state the classification, and explain the Fano plane (opposite only) and census 58 (own faces through two special points) by their pins.
status: Proved by FACE-CLAIM-20261103-001B-P001: across 305 handles from 24 non-planar knot spaces (the census's two and the Fano plane's splices with the planar census, both ways), in every port order on a ladder, the faces used depend only on the bottom port and nine signatures occur; the claim rule and its form in the handle's ports alone decide all 3,660 (case, face) pairs. The Fano plane's pairs pin the class of the met port and each single point removes one pattern per other class, so it never uses an own arc (proved) and uses the opposite face at every port; census 58 uses its own arc exactly when the bottom port is 0 or 5, the third points of its two lines sharing two points
title: The census of handles
